id: \rDon't you just love flowers? This is such a great place to live.
en: \rDon't you just love flowers? This is such a great place to live.
it: \rNon adori i fiori? È un posto meraviglioso in cui vivere.

id: \rHello, you must be here to challenge my husband Norman.
en: \rHello, you must be here to challenge my husband Norman.
it: \rSalve, sarai qui per sfidare mio marito Norman.

id: \rI'm sorry to tell you that he is out training right now and won't be back for some time.
en: \rI'm sorry to tell you that he is out training right now and won't be back for some time.
it: \rMi dispiace dirti che è fuori ad allenarsi e non tornerà per un po'.

id: \rHello, you must be here to challenge my husband Norman. Norman tells me not to give advice to Trainers, but May speaks highly of you.
en: \rHello, you must be here to challenge my husband Norman. Norman tells me not to give advice to Trainers, but May speaks highly of you.
it: \rSalve, sarai qui per sfidare mio marito Norman. Norman mi dice di non dare consigli agli Allenatori, ma Vera parla molto bene di te.

id: \rHe uses Normal type Pokémon, and his Slaking's Ability requires it to rest every other turn.
en: \rHe uses Normal type Pokémon, and his Slaking's Ability requires it to rest every other turn.
it: \rUsa Pokémon di tipo Normale, e l'Abilità del suo Slaking lo costringe a riposare un turno sì e uno no.

id: \rI heard you beat my husband. That's quite the impressive feat.
en: \rI heard you beat my husband. That's quite the impressive feat.
it: \rHo sentito che hai battuto mio marito. Un'impresa davvero notevole.

id: \bNorman goes off to train a lot, despite having his family here. I hope it isn't too hard on them.
en: \bNorman goes off to train a lot, despite having his family here. I hope it isn't too hard on them.
it: \bNorman parte spesso per allenarsi, nonostante abbia qui la sua famiglia. Spero che per loro non sia troppo dura.

id: \bHi! I'm Max. I'm obviously the smartest child out there and am granting you the privilege of letting me travel with you on your jouney.
en: \bHi! I'm Max. I'm obviously the smartest child out there and am granting you the privilege of letting me travel with you on your jouney.
it: \bCiao! Sono Max. Sono ovviamente il bambino più intelligente in circolazione e ti concedo il privilegio di farmi viaggiare con te nella tua avventura.
